location.description: The location where the autoscaling policy resides.

policy_id.description: The ID of the autoscaling policy to which the IAM policy is applied.

project.description: The project ID of the parent resource.

member/members.description: Identities that will be granted the privilege in 'role'.
member/members.security_impact: High. Granting roles to public principals like 'allUsers' could allow anyone to modify cost-impacting scaling configurations, leading to Denial of Wallet attacks.
member/members.rationale: To prevent unauthorized changes, permissions must only be granted to specific, known identities.

role.description: The role that should be applied.
role.security_impact: High. Granting primitive roles to an autoscaling policy allows users to make changes that could lead to significant cost overruns or service disruptions.
role.rationale: To protect against financial and operational risks, only users with specific Dataproc autoscaling roles should be granted permissions.
